phalaka.cp: masc. & neut. a board; plank; a shied.
phalaka.p: [Phala+ṇvu] (na) Google Translate ဒါန်၊ ထီ. 392.] (1) Shield; လျှာ၊ ကာ. (2) ပျင်း၊ Plank (3) (weaving) tortoise.

S: phalaka：m．板，木片，楯，たて，柱．-cīra 木片衣．-pīṭha 板座．-seyya 板臥床．
D: Phalaka，【阳、中】 甲板，厚木板，盾。（p234）
F: Phālaka，（fr．phāleti），【阳】分离者，打破者（splitting； one who splits）。Vism．413 （kaṭṭhaphālana）。

ဖလက（န）

C: phalaka：[m．； nt．] a board； plank； a shied．
phālaka，（m．） one who splits or breaks．
P: Phalaka，[fr．phal=*sphal or *sphaṭ （see phalati），lit．that which is split or cut off （cp．in same meaning “slab”）； cp．Sk．sphaṭika rock-crystal； on Prk．forms see Pischel，Prk．Gr．§206．Ved．phalaka board，phāla ploughshare； Gr．a]ζpalon，spolaζ，yaliζ scissors； Lat．pellis & spolium； Ohg．spaltan=split，Goth，spilda writing board，tablet； Oicel．spjald board] 1．a flat piece of wood，a slab，board，plank J．I，451 （a writing board，school slate）； V，155 （akkhassa ph．axle board）； VI，281 （dice-board）．pidhāna° covering board VbhA．244= Vism．261； sopāna° staircase，landing J．I，330 （maṇi°）； Vism．313； cp．MVastu I．249； °āsana a bench J．I，199； °kāya a great mass of planks J．II，91．°atthara-sayana a bed covered with a board （instead of a mattress） J．I，304，317； II，68．°seyya id．D．I，167 （“plank-bed”）．-- 2．a shield J．III，237，271； Miln．355； DhA．II，2．‹-› 3．a slip of wood or bark，used for making an ascetic’s dress （°cīra） D．I，167，cp．Vin．I，305．ditto for a weight to hang on the robe Vin．II，136．-- 4．a post M．III，95 （aggaḷa° doorpost）； ThA．70 （Ap．V，17）．（Page 477）
Phālaka，（adj．） [fr．phāleti] splitting； one who splits Vism．413 （kaṭṭha°）．（Page 478）

DOP: phalaka m.n. [ cf S., BHS phalaka] 1. a flat piece of wood (also of stone or iron); a board, a plank; a tablet (for writing on); a panel; D II 181, 23 foll. (pāsādo catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ ~ehi santhato ahosi ekaṃ ~aṃ sovaṇṇamayaṃ …); S II 102, 1 (cittakāro … suparimaṭṭhe vā ~e bhittiyā vā … itthirūpaṃ vā purisarūpaṃ vā abhinimmineyya); Thī 266 (kañcanassa ~aṃ va sammaṭṭhaṃ sobhate su kāyo pure mama); Ja I 451, 20 (seṭṭhiputte lekhaṃ sikkhante va dāso pi ’ssa ~aṃ vahamāno gantvā … lekhaṃ sikkhi); II 103, 6 (samuddamajjhe bhinnāya nāvāya ~e nipanno taṃ dīpaṃ patvā); IV 20, 27´ (sā hotu nāvā bahuhi susibbitehi ~ehi upapannā); V 49, 11* (khaṇitvāna kāsuṃ ~ehi chādayi); Ap 2, 7 (bahūnekasatā ~ā rajatāmayā, Ee, Se so, perhaps wr; Be, Ce phalikā; cf Ap-a 105, 27 : phaḷikā phaḷikamaṇīhi katā); 174, 9 (candanaphalakaṃ katvā adāsiṃ … ~assa idaṃ phalaṃ; Ap-a 444, 23 : taṃ ālambanaphalakaṃ katvā); 579, 22 (ussitā ~ā rammā sobhanti ratanāmayā); Vism 674, 31 (yadā issāsassa ~aṃ abhimukhaṃ hoti) = As 233, 24 ; Sp 332, 6 (dhuvanāvā anto khaṇitvā vā ~ehi bandhitvā vā katā); — ifc see aggala-, apassena-, ālambana-, gaṇṭhika- ( sv gaṇṭhikā ), paṭikujjana-, pāsaka-, pidhāna-; — 2. a bench; a board (to sit or sleep on); a (raised) slab (for chopping, gaming, washing); Vin II 149, 31 (~aṃ uppannaṃ hoti); III 8, 14 (nānāpupphāni ~e nikkhittāni suttena asaṅgahitāni); Ja I 369, 15 (ekassa heraññikassa ~ato anāpucchitvā ekaṃ kahāpaṇaṃ gahetvā); II 16, 1 (assa pitā ~e nipajji); III 179, 8 (ekaṃ ~aṃ āharāpetvā purato nikkhipāpetvā idha naṃ nipajjāpehī ti … hatthe chindā ti); 190, 3* (~enāham aplaviṃ); 461, 24 (saṅghanavakakoṭiyaṃ pīṭhaṃ vā ~aṃ vā pāpuṇāti); V 155, 23* (vimaṭṭhā tuyhaṃ sussoṇī akkhassa ~aṃ yathā); 457, 11 (nagaradvāre sālāya ~e vissamanatthāya nisīdi); Nidd I 493, 8 (imaṃ rattiṃ dukkhaṃ sayittha ~e vā taṭṭikāya vā cammakhaṇḍe vā …, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee saphalake); Ap 218, 2 (~aṃ santhariṃ ahaṃ); Sp 291, 4 (cīvaraṃ … doṇiyaṃ vā ~e vā ṭhapetvā … hatthena paharituṃ pana vaṭṭati); Ps II 46, 24 (morapiñchena ~aṃ sammajjitvā … nisīdanti); IV 191, 16 (macchaṃ ~e ṭhapetvā … phālesi); 237, 7 (~e maṃsaṃ viya koṭṭayamānāni); Spk I 131, 16 (te mahārahesu āsanesu nisīdituṃ asakkontā ~esu c’ eva bhūmiyaṃ ca nisīdiṃsu); Dhp-a I 348, 12 (etesaṃ galalohitaṃ gahetvā mama ~aṃ dhovāpessāmī ti, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se nisinnaphalakaṃ dhovissāmī ti); III 90, 21 (so seṭṭhino nhānodakena tass’ eva koṭṭhake tasmiṃ ~e nisinno nhatvā); — ifc see aya- ( sv aya[s] ), jūta, pāsāṇa-, rajata-; — 3. a shield; protection; Abh 392 (kheṭakaṃ ~aṃ cammaṃ); 1107; M III 133, 17 (mahantassa ~aṃ soṇḍāya upanibandhati); Ja I 72, 27 (pāramiyo va ~aṃ katvā pāramisatthen’ eva paharitvā); 356, 21 (yannūnāhaṃ … ekaṃ purisaṃ ~aṃ katvā tassa piṭṭhicchāyāya jīvikaṃ kappeyyan ti); Mil 356, 5 (~aṃ daṇḍaleḍḍulaguḷasarasattipaṭibāhanāya); Dhp-a II 2, 15 (tassa ~aṃ ca āvudhaṃ ca dāpesi); Mhv 25:63 (~aṃ pahari khaggena); — ifc see kheṭaka-; — 4. [ cf BHS phala] bark; bast; — 5. a term from weaving; ? Sp 726, 3 (dīghato vā kappiyaṃ tiriyaṃ akappiyaṃ katvā vītaṃ hoti ~e ~e dukkaṭaṃ); Vin-vn 850 (vīte nissaggiyaṃ vuttaṃ ~e ~e pi ca; Vin-vn-ṭ [ Be ] I 359, 13 : ~aṃ nāma turivītaṭṭhānaṃ, yattha saṃharitvā ṭhapenti); — see also turi; — °’- atthara , n. , °’-attharaka, m. , the covering of a board or bench; ? Ja I 304, 26 (~-sayanassa heṭṭhā āhāraṃ ṭhapetvā, Ce, Ee so; Be °’-attharaṇa-; Se °’-attharaka-); 304, 28 (°’-attharake nipajji, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be °’-attharaṇe); II 68, 17 (~e nipajji); — °- cīra , n. , an ascetic’s garment of bark; Vin III 34, 28 (Sp 272, 17 : °-saṇṭhānāni phalakāni sibbetvā katacīraṃ); D I 167, 2 ; M I 78, 13 ; — °- pāṇi , m. or f. , a flat wooden instrument for smoothing; Ap-a 443, 13 (pāṇikammaṃ akās’ ahan ti sārakaṭṭhena ~iyo katvā tāhi pāṇīhi maṭṭhakammaṃ akāsin ti attho); — °- pīṭha , n. [phalaka + pīṭha 2 ], a wooden seat or bench; Vin IV 40, 28 ; Sp 776, 11 (~aṃ nāma °-mayaṃ pīṭhaṃ atha vā phalakaṃ ca dārumayapīṭhaṃ ca); Kkh 2 157, 26 ; — °- pīṭhaka , n. , id.; Sp 45, 1 ; Dhp-a I 321, 10 ; — °- seyyā , f. , a wooden bed; a board bed; D I 167, 8 (Sv 357, 13 : ~an ti rukkhaphalake seyyaṃ); Nidd I 417, 12 ; — saphalaka, mfn. , together with the shield; Mhv 25:63.

Q: phalakacīra：y áo ghép từ nhiều nhiều mảnh vỏ cây，thường được tu sĩ ngoại giáo thời xưa sử dụng tỳ khưu không được dùng，trọng tội loại y phục này cũng nằm trong số y phục bị gọi là titthiyadhaja （lá cờ ngoại đạo）

Phalakacīra：Y áo ghép từ nhiều nhiều mảnh vỏ cây，thường được tu sĩ ngoại giáo thời xưa sử dụng．Tỷ kheo không được dùng，Trọng Tội．Loại y phục này cũng nằm trong số y phục bị gọi là Titthiyadhaja （lá cờ ngoại đạo）
